audit_findings.item: v12-v14 split counts, manifest output hashes and source ancestry
audit_findings.evidence: Parsed split files agree with committed manifest counts/hashes; v12-v14 valid/test file bytes are identical across versions.

audit_findings.item: legacy LCAO label provenance and method consistency
audit_findings.evidence: Four training records carry only REF_forces, config_type says LCAO, and frame-level source_method plus original calculation settings/input-output provenance are absent; v11 manifest global method caveat does not resolve these records.

The test matches the four force-only LCAO AgTi_2p7A_LCAO training coordinates and cell exactly by persistent IDs but PBC differs; it is also within the stated near-coordinate screen of PW-PBE AgTi 2.55 A and 2.60 A training frames.

Each residual is accepted only when A task state is completed and a compact verification/summary/extxyz archive on main has PASS, matching input/output/summary hashes, converged four-rank PW-PBE metadata, and finite correctly shaped labels.

All three frozen input hashes match their manifest; inputs contain no labels and have no exact or near match to v14 training under stated registry threshold. Holdout label bytes were deliberately not opened; A task states at the analysis commit are recorded in JSON. Keep labels out of every training/selection split.
The v14 energy-labeled base and the projected 3 residual additions have rank 4 over Ag,C,Si,Ti; projected rank is not evidence that labels/archives are complete.
No v15 training builder/output manifest exists in analyzed inputs; the v15 holdout inputs remain reserved from training and label content was not inspected. Do not claim v15 ready to train.

builder_acceptance_checks: Abort unless each training addition has a manifest-linked input hash, compact verified archive status PASS, converged PW-PBE summary, four MPI ranks, and matching extxyz/summary hashes.
For every frame, record exact label keys, method, config_type, source path/hash, IDs/elements, cell/PBC; require finite REF_energy and (N,3) finite REF_forces for PW-PBE objective rows.

Exclude the four legacy force-only LCAO frames from the PW-PBE objective until matched PW-PBE labels or complete settings establish consistency. If force-only records are retained elsewhere, explicitly mask missing energy targets; never zero-fill them as energy labels.

Before writing splits, detect exact and near duplicates by persistent-ID mapping plus per-ID element, cell, PBC, and same-ID coordinates; flag the AgTi 2.70 A test leakage and do not count it as independent evidence.

Keep all three frozen v15 registry labels out of train, validation, checkpoint selection, and hyperparameter selection; score only after the model/checkpoint is frozen. Existing v14-scored holdouts are historical regressions, not fresh v15 blind evidence.
Require energy-label composition matrix rank 4 in Ag,C,Si,Ti column order; report singular values and exact energy/force/frame counts.
Verify v14 valid/test source files remain byte-identical when copied, verify all v15 input and output SHA256 values against manifests, and hash every generated split after build.
Preserve atom IDs and element identity when joining frames; fail on reordered/missing/duplicate IDs, changed cell/PBC, nonfinite labels, or unexplained frame-count changes.
Keep v15 training comparison settings fixed to the V14 baseline for the first controlled evaluation; do not inspect or tune against reserved holdout labels before checkpoint freeze.
